## The Data Talent Challenge

Data science and analytics require specialized skills that are expensive and in high demand. Building a permanent team is slow and costly.

Many projects are finite: migrations, dashboard builds, model development. You need expertise for the project, not forever.

Finding data professionals who can communicate insights to business stakeholders—not just write code—is surprisingly difficult.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- Data scientists with Python, R, and ML/AI experience verified
- BI analysts proficient in Tableau, Power BI, Looker, and other platforms
- Data engineers for pipelines, warehousing, and infrastructure
- Analytics translators who bridge technical and business stakeholders
- Project-based engagements for migrations, builds, and implementations
